# Quick Start — 30 Seconds

**You have a requirement. Here's what to do:**

## 🚀 3-Step Process

### Step 1: Prepare (2 min)
Gather: Ticket ID, description, priority, context

### Step 2: Submit (2 min)
Use template: [requirement-analysis.md](copilot/instructions/requirement-analysis.md#intake-template)

### Step 3: Wait (1-2 hours)
Orchestrator runs 8-phase SDLC workflow. You approve at each gate.

## 🔄 SDLC Phases at a Glance

```
PHASE 1: Context + Impact (10-15 min) ← Start here
PHASE 2: Task Breakdown (15-20 min)
PHASE 3: Code Generation (45-60 min)
PHASE 4: Unit Tests (30-45 min)
PHASE 5: Code Review (20-30 min)
PHASE 6: Bug Triage (BUG mode only)
PHASE 7: Documentation (20-30 min)
PHASE 8: PR & Merge (15-25 min)
```

→ **Full details:** [FULL_WORKFLOW.md](FULL_WORKFLOW.md)
